why: Engine profile fields deliberately left out of the generated ENGINES reference table (lib/v6/f2-code-doc-parity.js). Launch argv, launch env, install commands and engine-internal hints are operational detail, and launch.env may carry values that must never be published. A profile field that is neither projected nor listed here fails the parity check (ENGINE_PROFILE_FIELD_REVIEW) until someone decides, in review, whether to document it or add it here. Kept as data rather than code so naming these fields is not mistaken for a code read of them (test/engine-capability-reads.test.js).
